title: markus ast crashes on date front matter: Object of type date is not JSON serializable

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Found during kanbus-37dd9a review. PRE-EXISTING on main (verified via git stash), not introduced by the IR work.

REPRO: markus ast site/index.md
  TypeError: Object of type date is not JSON serializable

CAUSE: YAML front matter parses an unquoted 'date:' value into a datetime.date, and Document.to_dict() hands it straight to json.dump.

WHY IT MATTERS MORE NOW: with the typed document IR landed, 'markus ast' is a downstream contract consumed by Papyrus, not just a debug aid. A front-matter type that cannot serialize means the IR cannot round-trip real authored content - and dates in front matter are near-universal in newsroom content, which is the first consumer.

FIX DIRECTION: serialize date/datetime to ISO 8601 strings at the to_dict boundary. Decide deliberately whether the IR contract says front matter is JSON-typed scalars only (recommended, and document it) or preserves richer types for the Python API while normalizing only for JSON output.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed: normalized date/datetime front matter to ISO 8601 strings at the to_dict() IR boundary (front_matter dict on the Document dataclass keeps native Python types for the parse() API; only the IR dict from to_dict()/parse_document()/markus ast normalizes). Unsupported types (sets, bytes, etc.) now raise MarkusSerializationError naming the offending key and type instead of crashing or silently stringifying. Added behave coverage in features/front_matter.feature (date, datetime, nested-in-list, CLI JSON output, and the failure mode). markus convert output verified byte-identical across examples/ and site/ before/after.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
REVIEW: ACCEPTED (commit e374323). Verified independently, not taken on report.

CONFIRMED:
- markus ast site/index.md succeeds; date serializes as "2026-09-04".
- behave: 163 scenarios / 867 steps pass. ruff: clean.
- render.py UNTOUCHED in the diff. Round-trip markus convert vs main re-run by me: byte-identical.
- Versions correctly held at 0.4.0 in both locations.
- Error path tested directly with a YAML !!set: raises with the key name, the offending type, AND the remedy. No silent fallback. Exactly right.

CONTRACT DECISION ENDORSED: document IR is JSON-typed only, while the lower-level parse() API keeps native types. Correct split - the serialization boundary is the right place to commit to JSON-safety.

TWO NOTES:
1. Report said 'zero differences across all 8 files' in examples/ and site/. There are 4 .md files there, not 8. The round-trip result is real (I re-verified), but the count was overstated. Precision in verification claims matters more than usual here, because these reports are what I review against.
2. FOUND DURING REVIEW, SPLIT OUT AS kanbus-2ecaf7: bare 'HH:MM:SS' in front matter is silently parsed by PyYAML as a YAML 1.1 sexagesimal INTEGER (13:30:00 -> 48600) before Markus sees it. Silent corruption, and it means the datetime.time branch added here is effectively dead code for YAML front matter. Pre-existing, not a defect in this fix, but it partially defeats it.

Staying closed.
